objective: Test dominant-region robustness of the eight frozen structural-role candidates while eliminating paired-surface pseudo-replication and checking source-status sensitivity.

dominant_region_selection.rule: region with largest candidate occurrence count; ties lexicographic

physical_object_normalization.rule: remove one terminal lowercase surface suffix a or b only when immediately preceded by a digit or >; otherwise preserve document ID

object_block_null.name: WITHIN_PHYSICAL_OBJECT_ROLE_ELIGIBLE_WORD_IDENTITY_SHUFFLE
object_block_null.description: Within dominant region and candidate role, shuffle opaque word identities only among role-eligible positions belonging to the same normalized physical object. Structural position, role-match flag, numeric layout and per-object word multiset remain fixed.

D0_candidate_gate.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across all eight frozen candidates

allowed: eligibility for later region-scoped probable structural-function admission
